Crucifixion.fact: Crucifixion is a method of capital punishment and torture in which the condemned is tied or nailed to a large wooden cross, beam, or stake, and usually left to hang until eventual death, which could take minutes to days. Crucifixion was extremely common in the ancient world—Persia, Carthage, and Rome are among several civilizations that are known to have widely used this method to execute condemned individuals.
